[Verse 1]
[Cm]Shouldering
[Ebadd11/C]the blame.
[Bbsus4]
[Bb]
[Cm]Walking in
[Ebadd11/C]to frame.
[Bbsus4]
[Bb]
[Cm]Like a ligh
[Ebadd11/C]ted silhouette,
[Bbsus4]Against
[Bb]a cotton sheet,
[Ab5]
Smothering the crease.

[Chorus]
[Bb]Tin can
[Cm]in hand,
[Eb]
Wait-
[Bb/D]ing for
[Eb]God to come
[Absus2]around.
But he
[Bb]never
[Cm]comes around,
[Eb]
He
[Bb/D]never
[Eb]comes around.
[Absus2]

[Verse 2]
[Cm]Quiet like
[Ebadd11/C]a mouse,
[Bbsus4]
[Bb]
[Cm]Building up
[Ebadd11/C]your house,
[Bbsus4]
[Bb]
[Cm]Just to tear
[Ebadd11/C]it down,
[Bbsus4]Leav
[Bb]ing us the pie
[Ab5]ces.
Do they ever fit?

[Bb]Tin can
[Cm]in hand,
[Eb]

[Eb]God to come
[Absus2]around.

[Eb]

[Eb]comes around.
